about: V-MKT : Marché (Cotes, Scellé pistes et catalogue, Mon scellé, Envies) et fiche produit. La première étape ajoute du scellé possédé et suivi et trois envies ; les deux dernières vident Mon scellé et les envies.

steps.name: mkt-cotes
actions: async () => { const retry = async f => { for (let i = 0; ; i++) { try { return await f(); } catch (e) { if (i >= 4) throw e; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); } } }; const c = await import('./js/state/collection.js'); c.sealedSet(903956, { qty: 2, cost: 150, at: '2026-11-08' }); c.sealedSet(377493, { qty: 1, cost: 160, at: '2024-03-02' }); c.sealedSet(271940, { qty: 1, cost: null, at: '2026-01-02' }); c.sealedSet(858381, { qty: 3, cost: 4.5, at: '2026-11-01' }); for (const id of [903954, 805594, 574594, 858381]) if (!c.watching(id)) c.toggleWatch(id); const W = window.WishDB; const mk = (id, name, lid, img, v, min, max) => W.make({ id, name, setName: '151', localId: lid, setId: 'sv03.5', image: img }, v, { min, max }); await retry(() => W.put(mk('sv03.5-025', 'Pikachu', '025', 'https://assets.tcgdex.net/fr/sv/sv03.5/025', 'normal', 0, 5))); await retry(() => W.put(mk('sv03.5-006', 'Dracaufeu-ex', '006', 'https://assets.tcgdex.net/fr/sv/sv03.5/006', 'normal', 1, 2))); await retry(() => W.put(mk('sv03.5-001', 'Bulbizarre', '001', 'https://assets.tcgdex.net/fr/sv/sv03.5/001', 'reverse', 0, 2))); return true; }

steps.name: mkt-mon-scelle-vide
actions: async () => { const c = await import('./js/state/collection.js'); for (const o of c.sealedAll()) c.sealedSet(o.id, null); return true; }

steps.name: mkt-envies-vide
actions: async () => { const retry = async f => { for (let i = 0; ; i++) { try { return await f(); } catch (e) { if (i >= 4) throw e; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); } } }; await retry(async () => { for (const w of await window.WishDB.all()) await window.WishDB.del(w.key); }); return true; }
